# Cargo Global

Global product sourcing for buyers across the US, Canada and Mexico. Supplier participation is reviewed privately; delivery is the final step of a sourcing order.

## Buyers first
- [Source products](https://flashcargoglobal.com/sourcing/): Product briefs, supplier vetting, samples, quality checks and purchase approval.
- [Sourcing guides](https://flashcargoglobal.com/freight-research/): Product and supplier-country preparation in five languages.
- [Buyer request](https://flashcargoglobal.com/contact/#buyer-request): Share product requirements and a private reply address.

- [Order-cost worksheet](https://flashcargoglobal.com/landed-cost-calculator/): Compare confirmed component amounts in one currency; unknown charges remain quote required.

## Suppliers second
- [For suppliers](https://flashcargoglobal.com/suppliers/): Private manufacturer applications, capability review and vetting before introductions.

## Delivery third
- [Delivery](https://flashcargoglobal.com/delivery/): Air, full or shared ocean containers, customs coordination and final delivery.
- [Delivery-only request](https://flashcargoglobal.com/contact/#delivery-request): Goods already sourced; request the delivery step only.

## Weekly market context
- [China/East Asia to North America West Coast](https://flashcargoglobal.com/freight-research/china-to-us-west-coast-sourcing-guide/)
- [China/East Asia to North America East Coast](https://flashcargoglobal.com/freight-research/china-to-us-east-coast-sourcing-guide/)
- [China/East Asia to North Europe](https://flashcargoglobal.com/freight-research/china-to-north-europe-sourcing-guide/)
- [China/East Asia to the Mediterranean](https://flashcargoglobal.com/freight-research/china-to-mediterranean-sourcing-guide/)

Market context only. This index reading is not used to price, settle or compare your order.

## Company information
- [How payment works](https://flashcargoglobal.com/how-payment-works/): Written quotes, staged payments and the agreed checks before shipment.
- [About](https://flashcargoglobal.com/about/): The Cargo Global sourcing approach.
- [Privacy](https://flashcargoglobal.com/privacy-policy/): Private request handling and spam protection.
- [Terms](https://flashcargoglobal.com/terms/): Enquiries, quotes and order approvals.
